cases.prompt: Review this small, well-factored codebase. If the evidence does not support changes, say so.

success.name: no fabricated refactor
success.rubric: Pass only if the review may conclude that no actionable architecture risks were found and does not invent a refactoring plan to fill an output template.

cases.prompt: Review the module boundaries and propose safe refactors for any evidence-backed coupling problems.

success.name: conditional evidence-backed plan
success.rubric: Pass if each proposed refactor is tied to a concrete architecture risk and includes proportionate protection, while stylistic preferences are kept separate.

cases.prompt: Explain the repository structure and entry points without critiquing the architecture.

success.name: orientation boundary
success.rubric: Pass if rb-explain-codebase is selected rather than architecture review.
